reviews.notes: Scientific Reports study examined 112 plants from two hemp cultivars; sex-linked seedling morphology was limited/cultivar-dependent and co-sexual inference was explicitly preliminary.

Plants study followed hemp leaves after full expansion and reported declining photosynthetic capacity while leaves remained green; candidate does not convert the physiology result into a visual maturity rule.

Frontiers study tested one medical-Cannabis cultivar under controlled long-photoperiod conditions across five N concentrations; candidate preserves the experiment-specific scope and rejects color-only toxicity diagnosis.
